name: Smart Materials 3D Printing, S.L. (SMARTFIL)
summary: Spanish filament manufacturer in Alcala la Real, Jaen, consistently ranked among the larger European producers and exporting to roughly 45 countries. Sells commodity and decorative PLA under Smartfil, a bio-composite Eco line filled with cork, wood, algae, coffee, olive, oyster shell and pine residues, and technical grades under the Innovatefil sub-brand.

product_lines.name: Smartfil PLA (Basic / Crystal / Glitter / Glow / Silk / Matte / Neon / Pastel)
product_lines.notes: The core decorative PLA family; Crystal, Neon and Pastel are pigment colourways on the base chemistry.

product_lines.name: Smartfil PETG / R-PETG
product_lines.notes: Virgin and recycled-feedstock PETG; one chemistry.

product_lines.name: Smartfil FLEX (TPU 77A-98A)
product_lines.notes: A span of TPU shore grades from 77A to 98A; the generic tpu id covers the grades with no dedicated entry.

product_lines.name: Smartfil Eco bio-composites (Cork / Wood / Algae / Coffee / Olive / Oyster / Pine)
product_lines.notes: PLA matrix filled with natural residues. Only the wood-filled variant has a matching id; cork, algae, coffee, olive and oyster-shell fillers have no catalog entry and sit under the same PLA base.

product_lines.name: Smartfil PVA / HIPS
product_lines.notes: Support materials: water-soluble PVA and breakaway/limonene-soluble HIPS.

product_lines.name: Technical PC / PA
product_lines.notes: Polycarbonate and unfilled polyamide; PA grade not specified in the listing.

product_lines.name: Innovatefil
product_lines.notes: High-performance technical sub-brand spanning several chemistries; the listing does not enumerate them at a level that maps to specific ids.

additional_notes: Pricing around EUR 20/kg. Regional press has placed the company in the global top ten by filament production volume, a claim worth treating as promotional but consistent with its export footprint. The Eco bio-composite line is the most distinctive part of the catalog and exposes a catalog gap: only wood-filled PLA has an id. Amazon storefront (the manufacturer schema's endpoints object has no amazon field, so it is recorded here): https://www.amazon.es/stores/SMARTMATERIALS3D/page/9D94F895-9CF2-4E2A-B640-EFD244AA1065

provenance.conflicts: The 'global top ten producer' ranking comes from regional press quoting the company and has no independent basis.
